concept: Managing your own commitments without needing to be reminded
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Franklin's self-reliance tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student manages a realistic set of overlapping commitments (school, activities, a job or chore) with no external reminders
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to organize and prioritize without prompting
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what system, if any, helped them keep track

assessment.success_marker: student describes a real, specific approach to self-managing commitments, not just 'I'll remember'
